text:
The plate holds two cross-section pieces of corn on the cob, probably cut from a small cob. Each piece is about 4 cm across and about 2-3 cm long.

Mass estimate: a piece with cob is roughly 40 g, so two pieces come to about 80 g. The cob itself isn't edible and is a large share of that weight, but the question asks for total grams of food on the plate, so I'll use about 80 g.

Energy estimate: corn kernels are about 0.86 kcal/g (boiled corn is about 96 kcal per 100 g). Kernels are perhaps 55% of the weight, so about 44 g of kernels, or roughly 40 kcal. I'll round to 45.

{"kcal": 45, "mass_g": 80}
